detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Hexarelin (Growth Hormone Releasing Peptide)

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C47H58N12O6
  • Molecular Weight: 887.04 g/mol
  • Sequence: His-D-2-methyl-Trp-Ala-Trp-D-Phe-Lys-NH2
  • Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Hexarelin is a synthetic hexapeptide belonging to the growth hormone secretagogue (GHS) class of compounds. It is utilized in laboratory research involving peptide structure and interaction analysis under controlled experimental conditions. This material is supplied in lyophilized powder form and is intended strictly for in vitro research and analytical applications.

Research Applications:

In controlled laboratory research settings, Hexarelin is utilized in the study of:

  • Peptide-receptor interaction modeling involving growth hormone secretagogue receptors (GHS-R) in isolated cell-based or cell-free in vitro assay systems
  • Analysis of peptide-mediated signaling pathways in in vitro systems
  • Investigation of structure–activity relationships of synthetic peptide analogs
  • Assay development and receptor-binding studies under controlled experimental conditions

All research applications are conducted in non-human, non-clinical experimental settings.

Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at -20°C.
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2-8°C and use promptly.
  • Maintain aseptic techniques during laboratory handling.
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

Hexarelin is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
